# {{PRODUCT_NAME}}

Generated by Niwar DevForge using the `flutter-mobile-auth` blueprint.

This is an EXPERIMENTAL Flutter Android/iOS authentication pilot composed from `flutter-auth-core`.

## Runtime configuration

Provide the backend API prefix at build/run time:

```bash
flutter run --dart-define=DEVFORGE_BACKEND_API_BASE_URL=https://api.example.test/api/v1
```

Production/non-local endpoints require HTTPS. Loopback HTTP is available only when explicitly enabled for local development with:

```bash
--dart-define=DEVFORGE_ALLOW_INSECURE_LOCALHOST=true
```

The application stores opaque backend session credentials through platform secure storage via the reusable DevForge module. The UI receives authentication state and profile data, not the session token.

## Current proof boundary

CI validates deterministic generation, formatting, static analysis, widget behavior, a real FastAPI/PostgreSQL/Redis authentication flow through the generated product test, and an Android debug APK host-build. Android/iOS device secure-storage integration remains a separate production-readiness gate.
